findings.name: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption
findings.description: Maryland provides a full exemption from real property tax on the dwelling (principal residence) of a veteran whose disability the VA has determined to be 100% service-connected, permanent, and total. The exemption can also apply where the VA finds the veteran permanently unemployable at a lower rating. The official pages reviewed did not state a home-value cap or income test.
findings.value: Full exemption of property tax on the veteran's dwelling
otherReqs: Dwelling must be the veteran's principal residence
Veteran must own the dwelling
VA letter must state 100% service-connected permanent and total rating, or a permanently-unemployable determination
findings.agency: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT)
documentation: VA disability rating letter (100% service-connected, permanent and total)
DD-214 showing honorable discharge or release under honorable circumstances
findings.sourceExcerpt: a veteran who has a disability that the Veterans' Administration ("VA") has determined is 100% service-connected, permanently, and totally disabling ... Tax-Property Article § 7-208

findings.name: Charlotte Hall Veterans Home
findings.description: Maryland's state veterans home offers assisted living, skilled nursing, and memory care to eligible Maryland veterans who are 62 or older or deemed disabled by the VA or Social Security Administration. VA per-diem subsidies reduce cost, and veterans rated 70% or greater service-connected may be entitled to the full cost of nursing home care.
findings.value: VA per diem subsidy of $148.71/day (nursing home) or $64.19/day (assisted living) as of Oct 1, 2025; full cost coverage possible at 70%+ service-connected rating
otherReqs: Maryland veteran who served full-time active duty (other than active duty for training) and was discharged/released under honorable conditions
Age 62+ OR deemed disabled by the VA or Social Security Administration
Certain non-veteran spouses of eligible veterans may also be admitted
findings.agency: Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families
documentation: VA or SSA disability determination if under age 62
findings.sourceExcerpt: A Maryland veteran who served on full time active duty in the U.S. Armed Forces, other than active duty for training, and was discharged or released under honorable conditions... at least 62 years of age or deemed disabled by either Social Security Administration or the US Department of Veterans Affairs... A VP1- 70% or greater Service Connected veteran may be entitled to the full cost of nursing home care.

findings.name: Edward T. and Mary A. Conroy Memorial Scholarship
findings.description: Maryland scholarship providing tuition assistance to veterans with a service-connected disability rating of 25% or greater who have exhausted or are no longer eligible for federal VA education benefits. Limited to 15 veteran awards per year statewide; separate eligibility exists for children/stepchildren of service members who died in service or became 100% permanently disabled.
findings.value: Maximum award of $13,689 for the 2025-2026 academic year
otherReqs: Service-connected disability of 25% or greater
Exhausted or no longer eligible for federal veterans' educational benefits
Limited to 15 scholarships/year for the veteran eligibility category
Enrolled at an eligible Maryland institution of higher education
findings.sourceExcerpt: A veteran...who either suffers a service connected disability of 25% or greater...The max award for 2025-2026 is $13,689...No more than 15 Conroy-Cryor scholarships may be awarded annually to Veterans who suffer from a service connected disability of 25 percent or greater; and has exhausted or is no longer eligible for federal veterans' educational benefits.

findings.name: Veteran's Credit for State Employment
findings.description: Maryland state government adds a 10-point credit to passing selection-test scores for eligible veterans, spouses of veterans with a service-connected disability, and surviving spouses of deceased eligible veterans applying for state jobs; an additional 2 points apply for former prisoners of war.
findings.value: 10 points added to selection test score (12 for former POWs)
otherReqs: Applying for a Maryland state government position using a selection test
Honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory completion of service
DD-214 (copy) must be submitted and verified before credit is approved
findings.agency: Maryland Department of Budget and Management (DBM)
findings.legalCitation: Md. Code Ann., State Personnel and Pensions § 7-207
findings.sourceExcerpt: An appointing authority shall apply a credit of ten points on any selection test for eligible veterans, spouses of eligible veterans with a service-connected disability, or surviving spouses of deceased eligible veterans...a credit of two additional points on any selection test for a former prisoner of war.

findings.name: Disabled Veteran License Plate
findings.description: The Maryland MVA issues free disabled veteran license plates to veterans rated 100% disabled or compensated at the 100% rate based on individual unemployability, permanent and total in nature. Plates are available printed with or without the universal wheelchair symbol.
otherReqs: Proof of 100% VA disability rating or 100% rate based on individual unemployability
Eligible vehicle classes: passenger cars, multi-purpose vehicles, trucks of one-ton capacity or less
findings.form: Application for Maryland Parking Placard/License Plates for Individuals with a Disability (for plates with wheelchair symbol)
documentation: Proof of 100% VA disability rating or individual-unemployability determination
findings.sourceExcerpt: issued in recognition of a resident's military service-related injuries...rated at 100% disabled or being compensated at the 100% rate based on individual unemployability, permanent and total in nature.

findings.name: Complimentary Vehicle Registration and Initial Plates
findings.description: Maryland veterans rated 100% disabled by the VA may receive complimentary lifetime vehicle registration; veterans rated 50% or greater may receive complimentary initial vehicle plates. This appears in the state's summary of service-connected veteran benefits; a full fee schedule was not published on the page reviewed.
findings.value: Complimentary lifetime registration (100% rating); complimentary initial plates (50%+ rating)
otherReqs: VA disability rating documentation
findings.sourceExcerpt: Complimentary lifetime vehicle registration [at 100% rating]; Complimentary initial vehicle plates [at 50%+ ratings]

findings.name: Complimentary Lifetime Hunting & Fishing License
findings.description: Maryland residents who are 100% service-connected disabled veterans, former POWs, or deemed unemployable by the VA can receive a complimentary lifetime hunting and fishing license covering the non-tidal angler's license, trout stamp, Chesapeake Bay sport fishing license, recreational oyster license, bow stamp, muzzleloader stamp, sika deer stamp, and furbearer permit. A related Universal Disability Pass permits qualifying individuals to hunt from a vehicle under the ADA/504 program.
findings.value: Free lifetime hunting and fishing license package
otherReqs: Maryland resident
100% service-connected disability, former-POW status, or VA unemployability determination
documentation: Letter of disability or certification from the Veterans Administration
findings.sourceExcerpt: A complimentary lifetime license is available to Maryland residents who are 100% service-connected disabled veterans or former prisoners of war or are deemed unemployable by the US Department of Veterans Affairs.

findings.name: Maryland Veterans Trust Fund
findings.description: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit core program of the Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families that provides one-time grant awards to help veterans, surviving spouses, and Maryland National Guard members overcome financial hardship. As of the research date, the fund is temporarily pausing acceptance of new applications while it processes a backlog of requests, so current availability should be confirmed directly with the agency.
findings.value: One-time grant award; specific dollar amount not published on the official page
otherReqs: Demonstrated financial hardship
Applications temporarily paused as of research date pending backlog processing
findings.agency: Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families (Maryland Veterans Trust Fund)
findings.sourceExcerpt: The Maryland Veterans Trust Fund is temporarily pausing acceptance of new applications while we process a high volume of recent requests and ensure timely review of those already submitted...provides one-time grant awards to help veterans, surviving spouses, and members of the Maryland National Guard overcome financial hardships.
